header.subject: Science
header.chapter: Ch.1 Structure and Function - Human Body Systems
header.title: What keeps us alive: chapter opener
header.goal: Children name a body system from its parts.

moves.do: Fire four quick questions; all answer together.
moves.say: “Which part do we think with?” → “Brain.” “Beats in the chest?” → “Heart.”

moves.do: Open p.1: finger under the four figures.
moves.how: Glosses: system نظام, function کام, skeleton ڈھانچہ.
moves.say: “Same body four times. At home, what keeps you alive?”

moves.do: Model figure 1: parts first, then the system.
moves.how: Glosses: circulatory نظامِ دورانِ خون, nervous اعصابی نظام.
moves.say: “A heart with tubes joined to it is the circulatory system.”
moves.think: I look at the parts, not the colour: a heart and tubes. So this is one system with its own job.

moves.do: Point to figures 2, 3, 4; name parts, then system.
moves.say: “Dark-red muscles, so it is the …” → “… muscular system.”

moves.do: Read the p.1 questions aloud; one neighbour minute.
moves.say: “Say the parts; your friend names the system.”

moves.do: Write 'Four figures'; do items 1 to 5 alone.
moves.how: Fig 3 system; parts of fig 4; fix circle 2; count; why four?

answers: How do all your body cells get oxygen?
each has its own parts and job
sections.stuck: Give figures 1 and 3 only; add 2, 4 when right.

moves.do: Say Ali's claim; five children answer alone, aloud.
moves.how: Is he right? Which figure holds each part?
moves.say: “Ali says the heart and the brain are in the same system.”

sections.correct: Not right: heart circulatory, brain nervous.
sections.success: I can name a body system by its parts.
sections.ask: Why not name a figure by colour?
sections.listen: Both red; the parts tell the system.

moves.do: Find the systems in questions 1 and 3.

expect.html:
GRADE 5 · SCIENCE · Ch.1 Structure and Function - Human Body SystemsDay 1 · 40 min

What keeps us alive: chapter opener

Children name a body system from its parts.
Bringtextbook p.1 · chalk Wordssystem · function · circulatory system · nervous system · skeleton
PRACTICE · 28 of 40 min
4′ 6′ 14′ 14′ 2′
OpenExplainWe DoYou Do✓
★ Your one thing today · in move

Opening

0–4′Full details ›
1

Fire four quick questions; all answer together. End: “The body has systems.” “Which part do we think with?” → “Brain.” “Beats in the chest?” → “Heart.”

2

Open p.1: finger under the four figures. Glosses: system نظام, function کام, skeleton ڈھانچہ. “Same body four times. At home, what keeps you alive?”

Explanation · I Do

4–10′Full details ›
3

Model figure 1: parts first, then the system. Glosses: circulatory نظامِ دورانِ خون, nervous اعصابی نظام. “A heart with tubes joined to it is the circulatory system.”Think aloud: “I look at the parts, not the colour: a heart and tubes. So this is one system with its own job.”

We Do

10–24′Full details ›
4

I START, YOU FINISH
Point to figures 2, 3, 4; name parts, then system. Class writes each system. “Dark-red muscles, so it is the …” → “… muscular system.”

5

ONE NEIGHBOUR TURN
Read the p.1 questions aloud; one neighbour minute. Fatima, Ali first. “Say the parts; your friend names the system.”Window side first: ““Skull, ribs, spine, pelvis. Which system?”” → Reply: ““The skeleton, because they are bones.”” · Stop: two claps, eyes on me · Stuck? “Show me where.”

THE BOARD BY THE END · Four figures on page 1: parts, then system

You Do · in the book

24–38′Full details ›
6

⏱ 24′ stop explaining
Write 'Four figures'; do items 1 to 5 alone. Fig 3 system; parts of fig 4; fix circle 2; count; why four? “Use the parts as your proof.”If stuck: Give figures 1 and 3 only; add 2, 4 when right.

Check 5 books · answers

1.muscular system
2.brain, spinal cord
3.How do all your body cells get oxygen?
4.four
5.each has its own parts and job

Likely mistake

Names it by colour. Ask: “Which parts?”

Check · exit ticket

38–40′Full details ›
7

Say Ali's claim; five children answer alone, aloud. Is he right? Which figure holds each part? “Ali says the heart and the brain are in the same system.”Ask: “Why not name a figure by colour?” → Listen for: Both red; the parts tell the system.Success: “I can name a body system by its parts.” 👍 or ✊ firstCorrect: Not right: heart circulatory, brain nervous.

Homework

at homeFull details ›
8

Find the systems in questions 1 and 3. Draw one figure. “Parts first, then the system.”

Full lesson plan ›
